sigma.name: The Sigma
sigma.description: Precision and a single marked priority target.
sigma.flex_help: Hit the mark with three weapon attacks to trigger one Verdict. Requires an eligible target.

cool-kid.name: Cool Kid
cool-kid.description: Mobile melee with aimed keyboard combos.
cool-kid.flex_help: Aim six keyboard beats, then land the directional ENTER! finisher. Move faster; projectiles and hazards still hurt.

alpha.name: Alpha Chad
alpha.description: Shielded frontline with slams and a countershock.
alpha.flex_help: Gain a shield, draw nearby mobs and land three slams. Finish with a countershock powered by absorbed shield damage.

ratio-blaster.name: Ratio Blaster
ratio-blaster.description: One aimed projectile. Stops at the first rival or cover.
ratio-blaster.legendary_description: Every fourth activation adds two 0.10P shots, 0.08s apart.

no-cap.name: No Cap
no-cap.description: Throw a cap through up to four rivals.
no-cap.legendary_description: A line blast follows the cap after 0.7s for 0.25P × rarity.

brainrot-feed.name: Brainrot Feed
brainrot-feed.description: Mark a location; explode after 0.45s in a 100U radius.
brainrot-feed.legendary_description: Three fixed side blasts follow after 0.3s; one secondary hit per rival.

keyboard-warrior.name: Keyboard Warrior
keyboard-warrior.description: Two keyboard strikes, 0.12s apart. One proc per attack.
keyboard-warrior.legendary_description: Every third activation finishes with a 120U, 0.25P arc.

ban-hammer.name: Ban Hammer
ban-hammer.description: Heavy wind-up. Pushes mobs and adds 15 boss stagger.
ban-hammer.legendary_description: A 220U fissure hits after 0.5s for 0.30P × rarity.

touch-grass.name: Touch Grass
touch-grass.legendary_description: Every third activation: 150U circle, +25% damage, 25% slow for 2s.

cope-shield.name: Cope Shield
cope-shield.description: Shield bash. A hit grants a 4% HP shield for 2s.
cope-shield.legendary_description: Every third successful bash adds a 5% HP shield for 3s.

chad-hands.name: Chad Hands
chad-hands.description: Two punches. Every third successful attack ends in a slam.
chad-hands.legendary_description: Third successful combo slams 140U for 0.60P × rarity.

personal-space.name: Personal Space
personal-space.description: Circular pulse. Hit rivals deal 8% less damage for 2s.
personal-space.legendary_description: Every second pulse adds a 4% HP shield for 3s.

built-different.name: Built Different
built-different.description: +8% maximum HP per level; heal only the added HP.

thick-skin.name: Thick Skin
thick-skin.description: 3% damage reduction per level, multiplicative with other sources.

timeline.name: Across the Timeline
timeline.description: +8% weapon range per level; projectile speed follows.

hands-on-sight.name: Hands On Sight
hands-on-sight.description: +7% damage per level to targets within 150U.

certified-w.name: Certified W
certified-w.description: +6% healing and shields granted per level.

no-cap-streak.name: No Cap Streak
no-cap-streak.description: Every fifth weapon activation: +10% damage and +1 piercing per level (damage does not scale with level).

let-him-cook.name: Let Him Cook
let-him-cook.description: Primary hits grant +3/4/5% damage, up to 5 stacks. Expires after 3s.

homie-check.name: Homie Check
homie-check.description: Every 8 primary hits: heal 3/4/5% HP. Minimum 6s between pulses.

big-chad.name: Big Chad Energy
big-chad.description: Every 10s in combat: shield 5/7/9% HP for 4s.

so-back.name: We Are So Back
so-back.description: Cross below 30% HP: heal 10/15% over 5s and shield 10% for 3s. 45s cooldown.

six-to-seven.name: Six → Seven
six-to-seven.description: Seventh primary hit explodes for 35/50% power in 90U. 2s cooldown.

w-squad.name: W Squad
w-squad.description: +25% healing/shields. Flex grants +10% weapon damage for 6s.

too-sigma.name: Too Sigma to Fall
too-sigma.description: Cross below 25% HP: shield 25% HP for 5s. 60s cooldown. Cannot prevent a fatal hit.

no-u.name: No U
no-u.description: Every 15s: 30% power pulse in 200U, reducing mob damage 20%/4s (boss 10%/2s).
